I25_Reduced_Quiet_Zone - 接口 中的静态变量com.android.hdms.configuration.ScannerConstant.ParamKey
Enable or disable decoding I 2 of 5 bar codes with reduced quiet zones
The property value should be set as follows:
0*: Disallow short quiet zone symbols.
I_2_OF_5_CHECK_DIGIT_VERIFICATION - 接口 中的静态变量com.android.hdms.configuration.ScannerConstant.ParamKey
Enable this feature to check the integrity of all I 2 of 5 symbols to verify the data complies with either the specified Uniform Symbology Specification (USS), or the Optical Product Code Council (OPCC) check digit algorithm.
I_2_OF_5_CONVERT_TO_EAN13 - 接口 中的静态变量com.android.hdms.configuration.ScannerConstant.ParamKey
Enable this parameter to convert 14-character I 2 of 5 codes to EAN-13, and transmit to the host as EAN-13.
I_2_OF_5_LENGTH1 - 接口 中的静态变量com.android.hdms.configuration.ScannerConstant.ParamKey
Set minimun length for Interleaved 2 of 5.Range: 0..55.Default = 6.
I_2_OF_5_LENGTH2 - 接口 中的静态变量com.android.hdms.configuration.ScannerConstant.ParamKey
Set maximun length for Interleaved 2 of 5.Range: 0..55.Default = 55.
I_2_OF_5_Security_level - 接口 中的静态变量com.android.hdms.configuration.ScannerConstant.ParamKey
Note: The property value below is only supported on platforms interfacing to the Zebra scanner.
